block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: The 8 Exploration stats, base modifier conversion, and bidirectional combat pairings.
what_it_enables: Bidirectional stat mirroring between combat growth and overworld capability
Standard 1-20 tabletop attribute scale with derived modifier calculation (MOD = floor((stat-10)/2))
Overworld skill checks: boulder pushing (STR), lockpicking (DEX), hazard endurance (VIT), rune deciphering (INT), intuition (WIS), persuasion (CHA), dark-vision (PER), and faction access (REP)
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations during attribute queries (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Exploration raw scores strictly bounded within [1, 20] at character baseline (up to 30 with relics)
Base modifier strictly evaluates to floor((stat - 10) / 2)

exploration_stats.name: Vitality
exploration_stats.combat_function: Governs maximum Health Points (HP) life pool and physical damage mitigation.
exploration_stats.world_function: Environmental hazard and poison endurance, sprint stamina, forced march resistance.

exploration_stats.name: Intelligence
exploration_stats.combat_function: Governs Magic Points (MP) ethereal reservoir and arcane/elemental spell power ('Science').
exploration_stats.world_function: Deciphering dynastic archives, ancient rune logic, alchemical synthesis.

exploration_stats.name: Charisma
exploration_stats.combat_function: Tactical Points (TP) momentum pool powering tandem martial arts and Statera auras.
exploration_stats.world_function: Diplomatic persuasion, merchant bartering, intimidation, squad companion morale.

exploration_stats.name: Strength
exploration_stats.combat_function: Melee weapon impact, shield bash force, physical armor penetration.
exploration_stats.world_function: Pushing heavy boulders on the grid, inventory carry weight, forced door entry.

exploration_stats.name: Wisdom
exploration_stats.combat_function: Spiritual warding poise, negative status condition resistance, barrier duration.
exploration_stats.world_function: Reading NPC ulterior motives, sensing malice, Dreamscape planar intuition.

exploration_stats.name: Dexterity
exploration_stats.combat_function: Turn order speed, action-battle evasion, grid traversal mobility.
exploration_stats.world_function: Lockpicking treasure chests, trap disarming, stealth stalking, obstacle leaps.

exploration_stats.name: Perception
exploration_stats.combat_function: Base accuracy (ACC), Critical Hit Rate, grazing hit conversions, battle loot luck.
exploration_stats.world_function: Spotting concealed caches, dark-vision in ruins, tactical terrain scouting.

exploration_stats.name: Reputation
exploration_stats.combat_function: Relic resonance recharge rate and companion tandem attack synergy.
exploration_stats.world_function: Socio-political standing across the 4 Pillars, shop tariffs, royal palace clearance.

tripwires.action: Ensure all 8 canonical exploration stats are declared
